title: Synthetic Data Generation Models Validation
summary: A research repository from the A2-PRIVCOMP project that trains and evaluates multiple synthetic tabular data generation models (with and without privacy guarantees), tracking results via MLflow and MinIO. Its 'without_privacy_guarantees' model set directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE synthesizers from the sdv.single_table API as baseline generators for comparison.
needs: Directory name 'sdv' is a category folder for models 'without privacy guarantees', not a vendored copy of SDV source; confirmed via import from installed sdv package.
